title: Dantzig's bound at a node
heading: A One-Row LP Is Solved by Sorting: Dantzig's Bound
cases: items fill in ratio order and the first one that does not fit is taken in part
when every item fits, the bound is their total value and the split is None
a cheap item with a lower value but a higher ratio is filled before an expensive valuable one
after the split item the fill stops, even if a later item would fit in what is left
an item fixed at 1 is paid for before the fill, whatever its ratio, and one fixed at 0 is never taken
items fixed at 1 that cost more than the budget give None
when the whole items use the budget up exactly, no item is taken in part
